item.description: শহীদ নূর হোসেনকে উৎসর্গ করে লেখা শামসুর রাহমানের কবিতায় উঠে এসেছে ভালোবাসা ও সংগ্রামের অনুভূতি। কবির পংক্তিতে প্রিয়তমার সান্নিধ্য এবং হৃদয়ের গভীর আবেগ প্রকাশিত হয়েছে।

item.title: Ravi Shastri describes the heavy pressure of coaching India
item.description: Ravi Shastri noted that leading the national team is harder than playing or broadcasting due to heavy responsibilities. He highlighted the lack of control during matches and constant pressure to win.

item.title: BJP uses grassroot campaigns to manage Uttar Pradesh voter mood
item.description: Party officials stated that engaging ground-level members helps address worker fatigue and complacency ahead of elections in Uttar Pradesh.

item.title: Utah judge schedules 2028 trial for Charlie Kirk murder suspect
item.description: Utah District Judge Graf scheduled a 105-day trial starting with jury selection on June 21, 2028, for the suspect charged in the killing of Charlie Kirk.

item.title: Manipur High Court halts census operations until April
item.description: A bench led by Chief Justice M Sundar and Justice Aribam Guneshwar Sharma issued an order on November 4 to halt the census until April 30 amid calls for an NRC update.

item.title: Asian nations oppose unilateral actions
item.description: Various Asian countries have expressed their disapproval of unilateral decision-making approaches in international affairs, emphasizing multilateral cooperation instead.

item.title: California Electorate Defeats Billionaire Wealth Tax Measure
item.description: Voters in California turned down a proposed five percent levy on net worths exceeding one billion dollars. Technology executives heavily funded the campaign to defeat the initiative, delivering a blow to progressive advocates.

item.title: Pawan Kalyan and Anna Konidala End 13-Year Marriage
item.description: Pawan Kalyan and his wife Anna Konidala released a joint statement announcing their separation after thirteen years of marriage. They stated that the choice was reached through mutual agreement and respect.

item.title: Sangeeth Prathap Praises Karthik Subbaraj's 'Dorothy'
item.description: Actor Sangeeth Prathap lauded Karthik Subbaraj's film 'Dorothy' on social media for its impactful storytelling. He stated that the movie left such a strong impression that he chooses never to view it again.

item.title: লি চ্যাং-দংয়ের নতুন সিনেমা নেটফ্লিক্সে প্রশংসিত
item.description: দক্ষিণ কোরিয়ায় দীর্ঘ ও ধীরগতির ছবি হিসেবে মুক্তি পাওয়ার পর থেকেই নেটফ্লিক্সে তুমুল আলোচনা তৈরি করেছে নির্মাতা লি চ্যাং-দংয়ের নতুন সিনেমাটি। মুক্তির মাত্র কয়েক ঘণ্টার মধ্যেই এটি দেশটির স্ট্রিমিং তালিকার শীর্ষস্থান দখল করে নিয়েছে।

item.title: Chennai Air Quality Reaches Very Poor Levels During Diwali
item.description: Chennai's air quality index surpassed 300 during Diwali, entering the very poor category. Valasaravakkam recorded the highest reading at 343, followed by Nungambakkam and Sowcarpet.

item.title: Russell Brand Receives Long Prison Term After Judge's Verdict
item.description: Comedian Russell Brand has been handed a prison sentence exceeding ten years. The presiding judge labeled him as a sexual predator during the sentencing.

item.title: Jensen Huang's Wealth Drops Amid Nvidia Share Pressures
item.description: Jensen Huang experienced a $7.4 billion reduction in net worth, causing him to drop two positions on the billionaire index. The decline followed downward pressure on Nvidia stock linked to an ongoing investigation.

item.title: Australia plans strict reporting rules following OpenAI data breach
item.description: Following an OpenAI incident, the Australian government proposed penal reforms to prevent firms from claiming ignorance in cyber cases. While OpenAI avoids charges for the Medicare breach, new legislation is forthcoming.

item.title: EU-Lisa takes IBM, Atos and Leonardo to court over border system delays
item.description: The European Union border agency has filed a lawsuit against IBM, Atos, and Leonardo for missing Entry/Exit System deadlines. The contractors attributed the setbacks to the Covid-19 pandemic, citing financial damages.
